feeding_claim.verbatim: We offer 100% Grass-Fed and Grass-Finished Beef, raised regeneratively and moved daily to fresh forage.

notes: Fifth-generation Manthe family farm (Monte and Robyn) in Cambridge, Henry County. Checked the homepage, about, store, how to order, locations and goat pages. The store sells beef as Grass Fed and Finished, pork as timber raised, chicken and eggs as pasture raised and goat as silvopasture raised; the goats are raised on the ranch by a family herd brought there. Orders are placed online for home delivery (zip code check, Quad Cities area) or free pickup at the farm, the QC Farmers Market in Rock Island, NOSH in Geneseo and Cornucopia in Galesburg. The site says longer distance delivery is suspended. It also sells wholesale to grocers and chefs. No bulk shares were found on the site; pork and poultry feed is not described.
